scripts.bundle: rollup -f iife -i out/scripts/index.js -o out/build.js -m out/scripts/index.js.map -n build
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run bundle
scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src/popup/popup.ts --watch src/scripts/handlers.ts --watch src/scripts/utils.ts --watch src/scripts/index.ts --watch src/background.ts --exec 'npm run build'
